title: Icebreaker
author: Hannah Grace
summary: A college figure skater and a hockey captain are forced to share ice time when their rinks close for repairs. Their early irritation gives way to something more as practice sessions and rivalry blur together.
readIf: you want a steamy campus sports romance with a mix of banter, slow tension and support from teammates.
skipIf: you are tired of hockey romances or want something outside the college setting.

pairings.reason: Another hockey romance on a college campus, a bit more fast and gritty in tone.
Similar high-heat rivals-to-lovers mood with a strong supporting cast and plenty of humour.
The same delight in two stubborn people sparring before giving in.
